question: $13.$ 设函数 $y = y(x)$ 由参数方程 $\begin{cases} x = 2\sin^2 t \\ y = t + \cos t ,\end{cases}$ $ t \in (0,\frac{\pi}{2})$ 确定，则 $\left.\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right|_{t=\frac{\pi}{4}} = \_\_\_\_\_\_$
